svg.text: Lost Passport and NIC Finder: architecture
Flow 1 registers found documents with an event-driven workflow. Flow 2 lets visitors ask a Bedrock agent whether their document is held.
reads reviews/{itemId}.json, sends SendTaskSuccess (APPROVE or REJECT)
out: NIC and passport regex, PII
Extract with Bedrock, validate with code
